- [Sully 模組](https://modrinth.com/mod/sullysmod)
- [Mo' Zombies Wave](https://modrinth.com/mod/mo-zombies-wave)
- [Mob Variants](https://modrinth.com/mod/fryc-mob-variants)
- [Majrusz 漸進難度](https://modrinth.com/mod/majruszs-progressive-difficulty)
